theme: Inflation and price indices for accommodation: BLS CPI lodging, Eurostat HICP accommodation, national CPI hotel components, Japan CPI, Australia CPI accommodation
queries_run: gh search repos "cpi lodging away from home"
gh search repos "japan consumer price index"
gh search repos "fred cpi lodging" (rate-limited, no results)
gh search repos "consumer price index dataset"

candidates.name: eurostat/hicp
candidates.what_it_holds: Official Eurostat R package (data.table-based, ~84 commits, 3 stars) providing functions to pull HICP price indices AND item weights from Eurostat's public database at any COICOP level, including the accommodation/restaurants-and-hotels aggregates and the finer 'accommodation services' class. Not a static dataset — a live API client maintained by Eurostat itself, so country x COICOP x month panels are one function call away.
candidates.why_useful: We already hold euro-area HICP accommodation, but this is the maintained official tool (vs. a one-off pull) — lets the team refresh/extend country-level HICP accommodation and restaurants/hotels series easily, including point-in-time re-pulls (gap #4). Duplicate of what we hold in substance but materially better tooling.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: euro-area HICP accommodation (already held), but this is the maintained upstream access method rather than a static pull
candidates.time_coverage: Full Eurostat HICP history via API (typically 1996/2000-present depending on country)
candidates.license: unspecified in fetched README (Eurostat GitHub org)
candidates.last_activity: actively maintained (84 commits; recent per repo page)

candidates.name: sabers13/Eurostat-HICP
candidates.what_it_holds: Repo explicitly described as 'Inflation trends (EU, country, COICOP) with YoY/MoM, weights, drilldowns' — i.e. a build that ingests Eurostat HICP by COICOP category (which includes accommodation services / restaurants-hotels) with weights and country drilldowns.
candidates.why_useful: If it commits the COICOP-level output (not just code), it's a ready-made country x category HICP panel that could isolate accommodation services inflation by country, finer than the aggregate euro-area series we hold.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: possibly duplicates euro-area HICP accommodation holding at coarser level; finer COICOP/country drilldown would be new

candidates.name: paluigi-moltis/hicp-weights-downloader
candidates.what_it_holds: Python tool that downloads annual Eurostat HICP item weights (ECOICOP v2 classification, all EU/EA member states and years) via the Eurostat API, saving output as parquet with columns coicop18/name/geo/time/value (weight in per mille). Weights only, not the price index itself — but weights for accommodation-related COICOP codes would let the team reconstruct category contribution to headline inflation.
candidates.why_useful: Useful complement if the team needs accommodation-services expenditure weights by country/year to weight or decompose HICP moves — a narrow but concrete gap-filler for point-in-time HICP construction (gap #4).
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: no direct duplicate; weights are a different quantity than the HICP accommodation index we hold
candidates.time_coverage: annual, full Eurostat HICP weights history
candidates.size_hint: small parquet output (not yet confirmed committed to repo)

candidates.name: agscott/AustralianCPI
candidates.what_it_holds: R project (CC0-1.0 licensed) that pulls the quarterly Australian CPI via the ABS API (script `1 ReadABS_API.R`), stores a processed `CPI.RData`, and renders an RMarkdown report (example output `Australian CPI 2023-Q2.html`). ABS CPI publishes a 'Domestic holiday travel and accommodation' expenditure class, so this pipeline is a plausible one-command route to that subcomponent, though the specific breakdown committed in CPI.RData was not confirmed by README alone.
candidates.why_useful: Directly targets the theme's 'Australia CPI accommodation' ask; CC0 license and a working ABS-API pull script make it easy to adapt/re-run for the accommodation/domestic-travel expenditure class specifically, which we do not otherwise hold.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: no — we hold no Australia CPI series currently
candidates.time_coverage: at least through 2023-Q2 per the committed HTML report; API pull could extend further
candidates.size_hint: single CPI.RData file + one HTML report; small

candidates.name: pipeworx-io/mcp-estat-japan
candidates.what_it_holds: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server wrapping Japan's e-Stat government statistics API, described as 'e-Stat (Japan) MCP — government statistics'. e-Stat hosts Japan's CPI series including the accommodation/hotel-lodging component; this is a generic client, not a stored dataset, and appears extremely new (0 stars, created/updated 2026-09-13, one day before this scout ran).
candidates.why_useful: Could provide programmatic access to Japan CPI accommodation data, which we do not otherwise hold, if it in fact proxies the e-Stat CPI endpoints — but the repo is unvetted, brand-new, and generic (covers all e-Stat tables, not CPI-specific).
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: no — we hold no Japan CPI series
candidates.time_coverage: N/A (live API access, not stored data)

candidates.name: andre-dussing/european-public-data-pipeline
candidates.what_it_holds: A hybrid Azure data-engineering demo pipeline (Bronze -> Silver -> Quality -> SQL Gold layers) that ingests Eurostat HICP data end-to-end into a SQL warehouse. Appears to be a portfolio/demo project rather than a maintained data source; category-level (accommodation) granularity not confirmed.
candidates.why_useful: Marginal — mainly useful as a reference pipeline pattern for ingesting Eurostat HICP, not as a data source itself; 0 stars, likely a learning project.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: duplicates euro-area HICP accommodation holding in substance if it surfaces category detail; unconfirmed

notes: Direct keyword searches for 'cpi lodging away from home', 'hicp accommodation services', 'cpi hotel component', 'bls cpi lodging', 'cpi accommodation', and 'fred cpi lodging' all returned zero GitHub repos — there is no committed BLS CPI-lodging-specific dataset or a dedicated accommodation-CPI repo on GitHub; this space is dominated by (a) generic macro/CPI API-client tooling (R/Python wrappers around ABS, Eurostat, e-Stat) that COULD be pointed at the accommodation/lodging subcomponent but isn't purpose-built for it, and (b) one-off student/portfolio CPI forecasting notebooks with no new data (excluded per instructions). Hit the GitHub search API rate limit once (403) after ~9 queries within a few minutes shared across other scouts; waited ~40s and the next two queries succeeded. No promising 'cpi hotel component' or dedicated Japan/BLS accommodation-CPI repos surfaced at all — if this theme needs real coverage, the more promising path is generic macro-data-vintage / ALFRED-style repos (a different scout theme) or FRED API wrapper repos filtered to the CUUR0000SEHB/CPILFESL-style lodging series, which this run's query set did not surface. Worth a follow-up scout searching 'fred api python cpi' or 'alfred vintage' broadly rather than accommodation-specific terms.
